picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would signal renewed price pressures, limiting Federal Reserve rate cuts and squeezing real household incomes.

picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.2% in November?
picks.why: A rise in U.S. unemployment would be an early sign of labor market weakness, changing the Federal Reserve's policy calculus.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil, so a lasting disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs and inflation elevated worldwide.

picks.question: OpenAI IPO closing market cap above $1T?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing above $1 trillion would test whether investor enthusiasm for AI reflects durable earnings or speculative excess.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-produced solution to a Millennium Prize problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads frontier AI shapes competition, market concentration, and where the economic gains from the technology accrue.
